#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#include <limits>

using namespace std;

struct FastScanner {
    istream& in;
    vector<string> tokens;
    size_t index;

    FastScanner(istream& input_stream) : in(input_stream), index(0) {}

    int nextInt() {
        while (index >= tokens.size()) {
            string line;
            if (!getline(in, line)) throw runtime_error("EOF");
            tokens.clear();
            size_t start = 0, end;
            while ((end = line.find_first_of(" \t\r\n", start)) != string::npos) {
                if (end > start) tokens.push_back(line.substr(start, end - start));
                start = end + 1;
            }
            if (start < line.size()) tokens.push_back(line.substr(start));
            index = 0;
        }
        return stoi(tokens[index++]);
    }
};

int n = 0, k = 0;
vector<int> kbeg, kend;
int numRotates = 0;
int minNumRotates = 0;

void SaveRotates(int num) {
    if (minNumRotates == 0) minNumRotates = num;
    else minNumRotates = min(minNumRotates, num);
}

void CalcRotates(int side, int* tmin, int* tmax, int noffset, int koffset, bool isInterval) {
    if (tmin[0] > n || tmin[1] > n) return;
    if ((tmin[0] <= n && tmax[0] >= n) || (tmin[1] <= n && tmax[1] >= n)) {
        if ((tmax[0] < n && side == 1) || (tmax[1] < n && side == 0)) {
            SaveRotates(numRotates + 1);
        } else {
            SaveRotates(numRotates);
        }
        return;
    }
    if (koffset == k) return;

    if (isInterval) {
        if (kbeg[koffset] == kend[koffset]) {
            CalcRotates(side, tmin, tmax, noffset, koffset + 1, false);
            numRotates++;
            CalcRotates(1 - side, tmin, tmax, noffset, koffset + 1, false);
            numRotates--;
        } else {
            tmin[side] += kend[koffset] - kbeg[koffset];
            tmax[side] += kend[koffset] - kbeg[koffset];
            CalcRotates(side, tmin, tmax, kend[koffset], koffset + 1, false);
            tmin[side] -= kend[koffset] - kbeg[koffset];
            tmax[side] -= kend[koffset] - kbeg[koffset];

            tmax[side] += kend[koffset] - kbeg[koffset];
            tmax[1 - side] += kend[koffset] - kbeg[koffset];
            numRotates++;
            CalcRotates(1 - side, tmin, tmax, kend[koffset], koffset + 1, false);
            numRotates--;
            tmax[side] -= kend[koffset] - kbeg[koffset];
            tmax[1 - side] -= kend[koffset] - kbeg[koffset];

            tmax[side] += kend[koffset] - kbeg[koffset];
            tmin[1 - side] += 1;
            tmax[1 - side] += kend[koffset] - kbeg[koffset] - 1;
            numRotates += 2;
            CalcRotates(side, tmin, tmax, kend[koffset], koffset + 1, false);
            numRotates -= 2;
            tmax[side] -= kend[koffset] - kbeg[koffset];
            tmin[1 - side] -= 1;
            tmax[1 - side] -= kend[koffset] - kbeg[koffset] - 1;
        }
    } else {
        tmin[side] += kbeg[koffset] - noffset;
        tmax[side] += kbeg[koffset] - noffset;
        CalcRotates(side, tmin, tmax, kbeg[koffset], koffset, true);
        tmin[side] -= kbeg[koffset] - noffset;
        tmax[side] -= kbeg[koffset] - noffset;
    }
}

int main() {
    FastScanner scanner(cin);
    n = scanner.nextInt();
    k = scanner.nextInt();

    kbeg.resize(k);
    kend.resize(k);

    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        kbeg[i] = scanner.nextInt();
        kend[i] = scanner.nextInt();
    }

    int tmin[2] = {0, 0};
    int tmax[2] = {0, 0};

    minNumRotates = 0;
    numRotates = 0;

    CalcRotates(0, tmin, tmax, 0, 0, false);
    if (minNumRotates > 0) {
        cout << "Full" << "\n" << minNumRotates << "\n";
    } else {
        cout << "Hungry" << "\n";
    }
    return 0;
}
